title: Newton polygons for the non-bipartite dimer model
summary: We study the dimer model on two families of non-bipartite graphs on a torus. The first family is obtained by replacing degree $3$ vertices in a bipartite torus graph with triangles, while the second consists of corner graphs associated with bipartite torus graphs. We determine the relationship between the Newton polygons of these graphs and those of the underlying bipartite graphs. We also identify the primitive edge vectors of the Newton polygons with the homology classes of the zig-zag paths.
